title: Handbook of Breath and Bore
summary: Drills belly breathing and sighting down the bore so a student with hardened skin learns a steady blow.

summary: Teaches silent stalking, held breath and low-noise blows for hunting small game without any qi.

title: Workbook of Cheek and Lung
summary: Trains cheek and lung breathing for longer blows and steady volleys in a student whose bones are hardened.

title: Plain Treatise on Dart Fletching

title: Guide to Steady Aim at Short Range

title: Canon of the Warning Puff

title: Handbook of the Joint Tube

title: A Primer for Qi Breath Shooting
